trans-unit.note: RACG resource; noun; Time Off Request label; It is a part of a warning message your receive when submitting Resource Allocation, and the allocation is in conflict with the time off request. The full string looks like this: "Time-off Request" + ": " + (start date of the timeoff) + " - " + (end date of the time off) + " " + "conflicting" + (time unit-e.g. hrs) + ": " + (amount of time)
